None of the 90 baseline websites was fully accessible, with an average of 80.43 violated interface elements. 13 WCAG SCs were violated at least once across the runs. Color contrast was the most prevalent issue, followed by labeling, semantic-structure, keyboard, and visualization failures. We reran 24 matched configurations with a general accessibility Skill and a contrast-specific Skill. Both significantly improved accessibility scores, but neither eliminated violations. User testing with blind individuals corroborated the experiential effects of the detected inaccessibilities. Moreover, functional correctness decreased with the inclusion of Skills. Our findings show that accessibility does not reliably emerge from vibe coding, and agentic interventions can both improve some accessibility issues and introduce new functional ones.

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

title: Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents
abstract: AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

title: FORGETMENOT: Auditing Memory Driven Privacy Risks in Commercial AI Agents
abstract: Commercial AI agents increasingly incorporate long-term memory (both persistent and chat-history) to enable more accurate and personalized responses, raises significant privacy and policy concerns. Yet little is known about user privacy risks associated with memory behavior, in particular, about memory storage, disclosure, transparency and deletion control. To bridge this gap, we propose FORGETMENOT, an auditing framework for analyzing the privacy risks of long term memory in commercial AI agents. Using our framework, we collect around 3800 multi-turn sessions comprising around 6M tokens across five popular AI agents. Our results show that agents store a wide range of personal attributes, including demographics, health, and sensitive details. Furthermore, user visible memory reveals substantially less (around 20% on average) attributes than the agents store in practice, exposing a significant transparency gap. Our stealth memory injection (SMI) technique further increases the amount of personal and sensitive attribute stored in memory, raising it by 25% and 15% for Copilot and Claude, respectively. We further observed memory deletion control is unreliable, as all five agents exhibit non-zero post deletion leakage, including health and self-harm related attributes. Finally, we demonstrate the feasibility of memory disclosure to a 3rd-party email recipient as a proof-of-concept, as Gemini shows 31.9% leakage rate. Together, our findings reveal notable privacy risks in commercial agents memory. Finally, we discuss both design implications and regulatory recommendations to protect users memory privacy in commercial agents.

title: Relativising Integrity and Robustness: Prompt Injection and Partitioned Enclaves
abstract: Relative security (RS) judges a system against a reference system, but has only been applied to confidentiality. We introduce relative integrity (RI), which states that every behaviour a system exhibits under an attacker's influence must be one the reference can exhibit for the same trusted inputs. RS and RI each choose their own reference runs, so together they accept attacks whose leak and effects the reference reproduces only in different runs. We therefore develop a further property, relative robustness (RR), which asks the same runs to reproduce both and is strictly stronger than RS and RI together. We give proof methods for RI and RR and a disproof method for RI, and apply them in two domains: (1) LLM agents under prompt injection, where the reference runs the same plan with a model that never obeys untrusted content, and (2) C programs partitioned across an SGX or TrustZone enclave boundary, where the reference keeps every function inside. We evaluate the properties on models of five published attacks, a support desk, an OP-TEE HOTP token and common agent defences. Two cases pass RS and RI but fail RR: an injection that makes the support desk's model accept any customer, as one input did in the Tensor Trust game, and the simulation step of the attack on Secret Network, in which an SGX enclave reveals a transfer's outcome without committing it. Our work is fully mechanised in Isabelle/HOL, with the enclave programs verified in C using AutoCorres2.

title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows. We then measure the effective horizons of 20 NLP, math reasoning, and agentic tasks and compare the two methods with Qwen2.5-7B. PG leads on short-horizon tasks, the two tie on the moderate-horizon math ones, and no task has a horizon in the regime where the theory predicts an ES advantage. Terminal-Bench has a far longer horizon. There, in a preliminary comparison with Qwen3.5-4B, ES without any credit assignment reaches a higher success rate than the PG checkpoint released with Tmax, as the theory predicts. ES should thus have the advantage on long-horizon tasks with few independent skills and a nonvanishing reward signal. Current benchmarks are only at the onset of this regime, so ES should become more competitive as agentic tasks grow longer.

title: DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
title_zh: DREAM：面向自动驾驶预期感知的双记忆推理框架
abstract: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.
summary_zh: 现有LiDAR语义分割多为逐帧处理，丢弃历史上下文，难以应对遮挡和稀疏观测等动态场景挑战。
提出双记忆框架DREAM，在线维护潜在记忆与误差记忆，通过轻量调制机制将检索结果融入特征空间。
骨干网络保持冻结且无需重放历史数据，在多个大规模基准上达到SOTA，显著提升动态与小型物体分割效果。

title: Agentic Root Cause Reasoning and Localization of Unsoundness in Static Call Graph Analysis
title_zh: 静态调用图分析不健全性的智能体根因推理与定位
abstract: Static call graph tools cannot soundly model every dynamic language feature, yet rarely reveal when, where, or why their results are unsound. We present CGRizz, an agentic framework that diagnoses unsoundness for developers and warns users about it. During training, CGRizz compares static and dynamic call graphs to identify boundary edges: calls observed at runtime but missing from the static graph. For each edge, an LLM agent proposes a root cause, including the unmodeled program pattern and responsible tool location. CGRizz validates each proposal using three independent forms of evidence: runtime instrumentation detecting the pattern, a test case reproducing the missing edge, and a warning inserted at the implicated tool location. Validated reports help developers diagnose limitations, while the warnings form an instrumented build that flags potential unsoundness in new programs without dynamic analysis. We evaluate CGRizz on three benchmark suites using WALA, OPAL, and Soot. Of 1,459 boundary edges, CGRizz reasons about 10.3% directly, all confirmed by manual audit, and resolves another 84.1% by grouping edges with validated root causes. Tool maintainers confirmed several limitations, some of which have been fixed. The warnings flag 74%-92% of unsoundness in held-out programs. Guided by CGRizz reports, a coding agent refactored programs to remove 64% of targeted root-cause patterns while preserving functionality.
summary_zh: 静态调用图工具无法完备建模动态语言特性，且很少揭示结果何时何地及为何不健全。
提出CGRizz框架，利用LLM agent对比静态与动态调用图，为缺失边界边提出根因假设，并通过运行时插桩、测试用例和工具警告三种证据进行验证。
实验表明该工具能推理并归类绝大多数边界边，其警告能标记大量未分析程序的潜在不健全性，还能指导编码agent重构程序以消除根因模式。

title: TPTL-dist: A Formalised Calculus with Proof Automation for Verifying Real-Time Distributed Systems
title_zh: TPTL-dist：面向实时分布式系统的形式化演算与证明自动化
abstract: We introduce TPTL-dist, a temporal logic and labelled sequent calculus for specifying and verifying real-time distributed systems. TPTL-dist is formalised in Agda to provide machine-checked correctness and tool support, including automation through a proof search that runs inside Agda. The logic extends Timed Propositional Temporal Logic (TPTL) with past operators, freeze quantification, comparisons between time expressions, domain-specific atoms, and an induction principle on time. We provide a world-based semantics, develop an interval-annotated calculus, and establish its soundness w.r.t. the semantics. To demonstrate its expressiveness, we encode standard distributed system patterns, and we carry out a mechanised proof of a key real-time property of the Pistis Byzantine broadcast protocol. Our results show that TPTL-dist provides a uniform, mechanised framework for reasoning about temporal properties of distributed systems.
summary_zh: 实时分布式系统缺乏统一的逻辑验证工具，作者提出时序逻辑与标号演算 TPTL-dist 并在 Agda 中形式化，提供机器检查与证明搜索自动化支持。
该逻辑扩展了 TPTL，引入过去算子、冻结量词、时间表达式比较与时间归纳原则，并构建基于世界的语义及区间标注演算，证明其可靠性。
通过编码标准分布式模式并对 Pistis 拜占庭广播协议进行机械化证明，验证了框架的表达能力，为分布式系统时序性质提供统一推理框架。

title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
title_zh: 面向 Video LLM 的观察条件化推理蒸馏框架
abstract: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.
summary_zh: Video LLM 师生模型因采样方式不同导致观察不一致，存在推理获取与执行间的差距问题。
提出获取到执行的蒸馏框架，将教师轨迹蒸馏为学生先验，并在多观察下优化其执行能力。
引入执行感知参考正则化，在多个基准上持续优于监督蒸馏与 RL 优化，且具跨域泛化能力。

title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
title_zh: Fin-RSI：面向LLM agent的金融技能、检查与自我改进统一库
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7% to 29.2%; for models with at least 14 billion parameters, it rose from 23.6% to 64.6%. We release the library and benchmark as a shared resource for the community and plan to expand its tools and task coverage as financial agents evolve.
summary_zh: 金融软件接口分散，导致构建可靠的LLM agent工作流困难。
提出Fin-RSI统一Python库，提供共享接口的金融工具、检查与自我改进能力。
实验表明工具发现机制显著提升有效程序生成比例，大模型提升尤为明显。

title: Cache the Knowledge, Not Just the Prompt: Dynamic Datalog as the Action Language for LLM Agents
title_zh: 缓存知识而非提示词：以动态 Datalog 作为 LLM Agent 的动作语言
abstract: An LLM agent that answers questions about a knowledge graph writes a program per question, and its tools evaluate each from scratch. We give the agent a Datalog REPL, a session over a dynamic Datalog engine, in which rules are inserted and retracted like facts while derived facts stay current. Prompt caching reuses the model's processing of what a session shares, and the Datalog REPL reuses the evaluation of it. On chains of questions over three knowledge graphs, agents reuse a relation that the REPL keeps in 179 of 180 cases, with two models, and write fewer output tokens: SQL and Python agents write 23 to 82% more. With SQL tables or a Python namespace, Claude Haiku 5.5 stores almost nothing for later questions, and a chain of seven questions at 13 million facts takes it a median of 48 and 56 s, against 31 s with the REPL. Claude Opus 5.5 matches the REPL by storing tables in SQL, and when the data changes it stores views, which are evaluated again at every read. A relation that the REPL keeps is read like a table and stays current like a view. Datalog is a niche language beside SQL and Python, and with thinking enabled the models answer as accurately with it.
summary_zh: 针对 LLM agent 每次查询知识图谱均需从头求值程序、难以复用中间结果的问题，为其提供动态 Datalog REPL 会话机制。
该机制结合 prompt caching 复用模型处理过程，并允许规则像事实一样插入与撤回，使派生事实保持最新状态。
实验表明，agent 在 180 次中 179 次成功复用关系，且相比 SQL 和 Python agent 输出更少 token，在开启思考时准确率相当。
authors: Bruno Rucy Carneiro Alves de Lima

title: Grounded in Contact: Reducing Floating and Interpenetration Artifacts with Multimodal Skill-Effect Models
title_zh: 基于多模态技能效果模型减少机器人操作中的悬浮与穿透伪影
abstract: Learning to predict the effects of contact-rich manipulation skills requires models that represent distinct outcome modes rather than a single expected result. Even for basic skills such as pushing, picking, and placing, small variations in contact conditions or object geometry can produce qualitatively different object motions under nearly identical states and actions. Deterministic and Gaussian models tend to average over these alternatives or represent them as a single broad distribution, obscuring distinct modes such as sliding, toppling, and rotating. We study probabilistic skill-effect models that learn multimodal distributions over object pose changes given partial point clouds and actions. We instantiate this abstraction with three representative model classes: mixture density networks, state tokenization, and flow matching, each paired with latent dynamics for next-step prediction. Across diverse objects and skills, explicitly multimodal models predict which outcome occurs more accurately than deterministic and Gaussian baselines. In planning, flow matching significantly improves task success over the deterministic baseline on every skill and achieves the highest success on every multi-step sequence. On a real robot, probabilistic models succeed at pick about twice as often as the deterministic baseline, providing evidence that probabilistic skill effects offer a practical abstraction for reasoning and planning under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 接触式操作中微小变化会导致截然不同的结果，确定性或高斯模型会掩盖滑动、翻倒等多模态结果。
研究基于点云与动作预测物体位姿变化的多模态分布，采用混合密度网络、状态标记和流匹配三类模型。
多模态模型预测更准确，流匹配在规划中显著提升成功率，真实机器人抓取成功率约为基线的两倍。
comment: Under review. Project page: https://grounded-in-contact.github.io/. The second and third authors contributed equally

title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
title_zh: 基于情绪理论的LLM可解释情感与心理健康推理
abstract: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.
summary_zh: 现有情感检测多直接分类，忽略了评估个体为何产生特定情绪的认知过程。
提出基于心理学理论的PsyCoT提示策略，用于情感分析、压力分析及抑郁识别等主观NLP任务。
实验表明，PsyCoT优于标准CoT提示，在多模型、多语言任务中F1分数提升0.5%至28.1%。

title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
title_zh: Wactorz：支持边缘自修复与迁移的长期存活 LLM agent 运行时
abstract: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.
summary_zh: 现有 LLM agent 框架多为短生命周期，难以适应物理环境需长期运行且容忍自身缺陷的需求。
提出开源运行时 Wactorz，将 LLM 生成的 agent 作为受监督的长期 actor，崩溃时仅重启该 actor 并保留状态，基于 MQTT 实现边缘节点间的生成与实时迁移。
演示表明系统可在四分钟内完成自动化构建、自修复代码及跨节点迁移，扩展版还补充了主题图视图、安全模型及系统局限等细节。
comment: 5 pages. 2 figues. Extended version of a paper accepted to the AAAI-27 Demonstrations Program. Code: https://github.com/waldiez/wactorz

title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
title_zh: 权重编码：用 LLM agent 直接编辑权重演进推荐模型
abstract: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. After reinitializing the entire 13.6M-parameter interaction module randomly while retaining the surrounding trained model, searching 2,448 mixing and normalization parameters yields 9.8 points above production. Offline gains span the full funnel including dense retrieval, generative retrieval and ranking, with up to 1.37B learnable parameters and different edits for each architecture. Steering edits provide explicit control of model performance over segments like freshness and product. Weight coding requires no serving change and online A/B tests increase saves per user from the edited retrieval source by 8.4\% to 10.7\%, aligned with the target business objectives. Our results establish weight coding as a practical and useful tool for model development and and behavioral control in a real web-scale production system, with potential to extend to both pre-training and post-training stages across the funnel.
summary_zh: 大规模推荐模型演进依赖重训或微调，成本较高，需探索更直接的模型更新方式。
提出 weight coding 方法，由 LLM agent 检查模型并生成可执行权重编辑，结合缓存前向评估反馈迭代优化。
在 Pinterest 生产模型上显著提升召回率，在线 A/B 测试提升用户收藏量，且无需更改线上部署。

title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
title_zh: KernelShift：评估硬件演进下的内核优化基准
abstract: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.
summary_zh: 硬件架构扩展不断演进，给CPU内核优化带来挑战，需评估coding agent在适应新扩展时的表现。
构建KernelShift基准，从真实代码库提取99个内核，支持agent利用目标硬件反馈进行优化。
agent在成熟扩展上优于编译器和通用库，但在端到端LLM推理中实现加速，且难以适应需新编程模型的扩展。
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 22 tables. Project page: https://cmu-l3.github.io/kernel-shift/

title: Social Interaction Breaks Replicate Independence in Controlled-Clone LLM Agents
title_zh: 社交互动打破受控克隆 LLM agent 的重复独立性
abstract: Multi-agent LLM evaluations and social simulations create many agents from one model and treat them as independent replicates, even after the agents interact. This assumption remains untested with matched controls. We introduce SocCogEval, a controlled-clone assay for Social Cognitive Transfer (SCT). Clones share the base model, system prompt, and decoding parameters and differ only in a private brief, and a factorial protocol separates the brief, 30 rounds of interaction, and initialization noise. On Qwen3-122B-FP8, interaction with the briefs held fixed raises off-topic BFI-10 response-profile drift by $\barΔ=+0.917$ and $+0.912$ in two topically disjoint scenarios (exact $p=0.0008$ and $0.0039$). The drift is larger than under the brief alone, persists under temperature-zero re-probing, and stays positive without typed memory extraction in exploratory tests. Matched solo generation reproduces part of it, and social interaction remains highest. Across five more model variants, every scenario-averaged interaction contrast is positive. Each interacting population is therefore one replicate, and treating its agents as independent requires paired no-interaction controls. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/koanatakiyo/SocCogEval.
summary_zh: 多 agent LLM 评估常将同模型生成的 agent 视为独立重复样本，但该假设缺乏匹配对照验证。
提出受控克隆测试方法 SocCogEval，通过因子化协议分离私有简报、互动轮次与初始化噪声。
实验表明社交互动引发显著响应漂移且高于单独生成，证明互动群体仅算一个重复样本，需配对无互动对照。

title: Non unitary and nonlinear quantum generative large model design and fast large-scale training without back propagation
title_zh: 非酉非线性量子生成大模型设计及无反向传播快速训练
abstract: Transformer-based large models require huge computational and storage costs. Quantum computation is expected to address that due to its potential to speed up classical algorithms exponentially. Key challenges of implementing quantum large models include the linear, unitary nature of qubit evolutions contrast with the non-unitary matrices and nonlinear functions in classical Transformers, as well as the difficulty of implementing gradient back-propagation on quantum hardware. Here we propose a fully quantum large model containing all the Transformer layers, implementing the non-unitary transformations through SVD-decomposition-based quantum circuits, and approximated nonlinear activation functions through pre-trained parameterized quantum circuits. We also propose a quantum circuit training algorithm based on multi-agent Reinforcement Learning, which can train large-scale parameterized quantum circuits without back-propagation. The dependency between the inference time complexity and the model's hidden dimension has been reduced from polynomial to logarithmic, showing an exponential advantage. The inference executions on the quantum hardware verify our model's 300-1000 times speed-up, and the measurements on the sequence-to-sequence tasks shows its learning ability. The training algorithm achieves only 25% complexity of the best SOTA quantum circuit training algorithms, especially this ratio decreases fast as the parameter scale increases. Our work not only proposes a quantum large model that can significantly reduce the computational cost, but also promotes the quantum computation towards general computing.
summary_zh: 经典Transformer大模型计算与存储成本巨大，且量子硬件难以实现非酉变换、非线性激活与梯度反向传播
提出全量子大模型，利用SVD分解电路实现非酉变换，并用参数化量子电路逼近非线性激活，结合多智能体强化学习实现无反向传播训练
推理时间复杂度降至对数级并获指数优势，硬件验证300-1000倍加速，训练复杂度仅为SOTA的25%

title: Think Before You Forecast: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: 三思而后预测：扩展时间序列预测的测试时计算
abstract: Test-time compute has become an important paradigm in computer vision and language modeling, where additional computation at inference time enables models to explore multiple candidate solutions and select or refine the most reliable one. However, time series forecasting models typically produce predictions through a single forward pass, leaving them vulnerable to distribution shifts and non-stationarity that frequently arise in real-world temporal data. We propose Time Test Compute for Time Series (TTC4TS), an architecture-agnostic framework that improves the predictive performance of frozen forecasting models at inference time. Given a pretrained backbone, the generator produces multiple candidate forecast trajectories using augmentation, retrieval, adapter. The synthesizer then selects or combines these candidates using aggregation, classification, or candidate-scoring and ranking methods to produce the final forecast. By increasing the number of candidates, TTC4TS scales test-time compute without retraining the forecasting backbone. Beyond improving point-forecast accuracy, TTC4TS can exploit candidate forecasts for uncertainty quantification, which supports improved interval forecasts. We also theoretically analyze when additional test-time computation improves forecasting. Experiments across diverse datasets and backbones demonstrate consistent gains in accuracy and calibration. Code is provided in https://github.com/Anoise/TTC4TS.
summary_zh: 传统时间序列预测依赖单次前向传播，难以应对真实数据中的分布偏移与非平稳性问题。
提出架构无关的TTC4TS框架，通过生成器产生多条候选轨迹，再由合成器进行选择或组合输出最终预测。
无需重训骨干网络即可提升预测精度并支持不确定性量化，实验证明其在准确性与校准性上均有稳定提升。

title: Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 面向工业异常检测的证据引导视觉搜索框架
abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.
summary_zh: 现有 MLLM 方法难以获取并验证细粒度视觉证据，导致工业场景下的细微异常识别不够可靠。
提出 EVAD 框架，结合全局评估与 MCTS 策略，通过语义细化与空间扩展主动搜索并整合诊断性视觉证据。
实验表明该方法在多数工业异常检测任务中达到 SOTA，验证了主动证据探索对细粒度异常推理的有效性。

title: Real-Time Kinodynamic Multi-Agent Motion Planning
title_zh: 实时运动学多智能体运动规划
abstract: Coordinating large robot fleets, from warehouses to quadrotor swarms, requires collision-free trajectories that satisfy dynamic constraints and stay within speed and acceleration bounds. Existing kinodynamic multi-agent planners enforce these bounds during the search or through trajectory optimization after it, which limits fleet size and speed. We present Tickwise Actions to Kinodynamic Trajectories (TAKT), a framework that accounts for the dynamics before the search and reduces planning to a lattice search for double-integrator robots. TAKT analytically bounds the clearance lost when a discrete plan is smoothed and reserves this margin on the lattice. A closed-form convolution provably converts any valid plan into dynamically feasible trajectories with continuous-time collision avoidance. For robots spanning many lattice vertices, we introduce a diamond formulation that permits one-tick sideways yielding and adapt the Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) solvers PIBT and LaCAM to it. With 50 robots, our planners run over 2,000 times faster than the strongest baseline in 2D halls and over 100 times in 3D, with comparable or lower makespan and cost. They plan about a thousand robots in seconds in 2D, and tens of seconds in 3D, and replan up to a thousand robots in real time.
summary_zh: 大规模机器人编队需要满足动力学约束的无碰撞轨迹，现有方法在搜索中或优化时强制约束，限制了规模与速度。
提出TAKT框架，在搜索前处理动力学，将规划简化为格搜索，并解析地预留平滑轨迹时的安全余量。
实验表明，在50个机器人场景下规划速度远超基线，可对上千机器人实现秒级规划与实时重规划。

title: ParseGap: Testing What Coding Agents Authorize and What Shells Execute
title_zh: ParseGap：测试编码代理授权与Shell执行差异的框架
abstract: LLM coding agents authorize shell commands by parsing a command string against a policy and passing the raw string to a system shell, so the gate adjudicates one reading while the shell executes another. We present ParseGap, a differential testing framework that runs each command through an unmodified vendor checker and GNU Bash 5.2 in an isolated container, flagging a violation whenever an approved command produces policy-violating runtime effects. Across eight production coding agents, ParseGap identifies 17 root causes across three divergence boundaries: at the parse, where an upstream tree-sitter-bash defect hides a second command from Mistral Vibe and Gemini CLI; at the utility, where every checker permits read-only binaries whose arguments write files or launch programs (9-47 of 55 cases); and at confinement, where an allow rule in OpenAI Codex CLI disables its read-only OS sandbox. Live trials across two frontier models triggered policy violations in all 16 agent-model pairs (14 under configured restrictions). To eliminate the second reading, we design ShellPlan, which compiles a strict Bash subset once into a typed execution plan, validates utility arguments against positive capability specifications, and dispatches approved plans directly via execve without a shell. Over a formal operational model, we prove single-interpretation dispatch and bound touched programs and files under audited assumptions. ShellPlan admitted 0/4,174 active attacks across six static suites and 0/90 hits in a ten-model agent benchmark (62/90 unguarded) at 1.28 ms median gate latency, preserving 36/36 (100%) frontier standard-dev completion (74/100 overall) and 0/348 external over-allows outside modeled exceptions.
summary_zh: LLM编码代理的策略检查器与系统Shell对命令的解析存在差异，导致代理批准的命令在执行时违反安全策略。
提出差异测试框架ParseGap，在隔离容器中对比厂商检查器与Bash的执行结果，在8个代理中发现17类根因。
设计ShellPlan将Bash子集编译为类型化执行计划并直接调度，形式化证明单一解释，有效抵御全部攻击且不损失开发能力。
在16个代理-模型对中均触发策略违规，验证了该安全漏洞的普遍性与严重性。
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Preprint with coordinated-disclosure redactions (all affected vendors notified on November 22, 2026 under a 90-day disclosure window)

title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
title_zh: 递归自编辑：LLM编写自身权重实现自我改进
abstract: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.
summary_zh: 现有LLM自我改进依赖梯度下降更新权重，而非模型自主编写更新。
提出SELFWRITE方法，让模型在Python会话中分析自身推理与权重，编写程序构建低秩权重编辑，无需梯度工具。
实验表明该方法在数学问题上提升模型准确率，证明LLM能无梯度地自主编辑权重并持续改进。

title: MAWAM: Joint Imagination for Collaborative Robot Manipulation with a Multi-Agent World Action Model
title_zh: MAWAM：面向多机器人协作操作的多智能体世界动作模型
abstract: World action models (WAMs) excel at robot manipulation by imagining future observations and decoding actions from them, yet remain confined to a single embodied agent. In practice, manipulation often requires multiple robots to collaborate across disjoint workspaces, coupled timing, and heterogeneous embodiments. Such coordination demands both spatiotemporal alignment of future interactions and awareness of individual embodiment and role identities, whereas existing decentralized per-robot policies, flat centralized models, and multi-robot VLAs fail to unite both. To bridge this gap, we present MAWAM, a multi-agent world action model that jointly predicts the future observations of multiple embodiments and decodes each agent's actions from them for collaborative manipulation. Through an agent-axis curriculum, MAWAM expands a single-agent WAM along an agent dimension to coordinate teams under shared weights. Within one unified causal sequence, joint self-attention spans all agents to spatiotemporally align their imagined futures, while hierarchical language, identity encodings, and embodiment masks bind each stream to its role, identity, and embodiment. We further formalize multi-agent-necessary manipulation along three axes (why, when, and who) and develop MA-Task Harness, a coding-agent pipeline where mutually constraining generators and evaluators co-evolve customizable simulation-data and evaluation packages. Using this pipeline, we build MA-Bench across all axes with seven tasks, pairing joint success rate with role and collaboration scores for fine-grained analysis. On MA-Bench, MAWAM reaches 82.7% mean joint success, 30.7% above the strongest baseline, and achieves real-time closed-loop collaboration on a real heterogeneous robot team.
summary_zh: 现有世界动作模型局限于单机器人，难以应对多机器人协作中跨工作空间、时序耦合与异构实体协同的挑战。
提出多智能体世界动作模型MAWAM，通过共享权重与统一因果序列联合预测多智能体未来观测并解码各自动作。
构建评测基准MA-Bench，模型取得82.7%平均联合成功率，较最强基线提升30.7%，并在真实异构机器人团队实现实时闭环协作。

title: Gossamer: A Utility-Driven Architecture for Constant-Budget KV Cache Compression in Reasoning LLMs
title_zh: Gossamer：面向推理LLM的定预算KV缓存压缩架构
abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to complex reasoning tasks, yet their inference efficiency is fundamentally constrained by the rapid growth of the KV cache. As reasoning contexts extend to hundreds of thousands of tokens, the key-value (KV) cache becomes the dominant contributor to both memory footprint and bandwidth demand, tightly coupling computation with memory utilization and thereby limiting scalability. Existing compression methods, such as quantization and eviction, alleviate capacity pressure but remain purely algorithmic, often introducing additional passes and compute overhead that reduce system efficiency. This paper presents Gossamer, a KV cache compression architecture for reasoning LLMs that bridges the algorithm--system--hardware gap. Gossamer introduces a unified utility-based action framework that dynamically selects compression operations, quantization, merging, or eviction, under a constant KV cache budget. Through cross-domain co-design, we fuse cosine-similarity estimation directly into the attention computation, exploiting idle compute cycles to perform similarity evaluation without latency or bandwidth cost. We call this mechanism Free-Lunch Utilization. This enables real-time, fine-grained KV management with near-constant memory usage and negligible overhead. Under tight memory constraints, Gossamer sustains reasoning quality comparable to uncompressed inference while improving end-to-end throughput by up to 16.7$\times$ over uncompressed baselines, 5.5$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ over the quantization-based Oaken and Ecco, and 1.8$\times$ over the eviction-based R-KV.
summary_zh: 复杂推理任务中KV cache快速增长，现有量化或驱逐等压缩方法引入额外计算开销，降低系统效率。
提出Gossamer架构，在恒定预算下基于效用动态选择量化、合并或驱逐操作，实现算法、系统与硬件协同设计。
利用空闲计算周期融合余弦相似度估计，实现无额外开销的实时KV管理，在保持推理质量的同时提升端到端吞吐量。
在严格内存约束下，推理质量与未压缩相当，端到端吞吐量相比未压缩基线提升达16.7倍。

title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
title_zh: CoHABIT：基于空间规则与家庭日常的家具布局评估框架
abstract: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.
summary_zh: 针对家具布局评估问题，提出CoHABIT框架，结合空间规则与家庭日常进行互补评估，全面衡量布局质量。
静态评估捕捉几何有效性、人机工效与功能组织等设计偏好，动态评估利用学习的居民策略模拟多智能体家庭活动。
实验表明空间标准与家庭行为揭示布局质量的不同方面，居民特征与日程影响排名，实现可解释的评估。

title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
title_zh: 超越准确率：LLM agent假设驱动实验规划的诊断基准
abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.
summary_zh: 现有评估仅关注最终准确率，掩盖了LLM agent推理失败的环节。
提出诊断框架，量化探索行为并将推理分解为四个可解释步骤分别评分。
发现强agent优于基线且推理各步稳定，弱agent难以将假设转化为可执行设计与对比预测。
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. 41 pages, 6 figures. Project website: https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/

title: Voice Agents: From Auditory Intelligence to Auditory Agency
title_zh: 语音Agent：从听觉智能到听觉能动性
abstract: Voice systems increasingly combine streaming speech, persistent state, reasoning, tool use, and embodied control. Once these functions share a runtime, spoken input can change digital or physical state, and recognition or response quality alone no longer characterizes the system. This article studies the interfaces through which spoken evidence becomes consequential. \emph{Auditory intelligence} denotes the capabilities required to perceive, understand, coordinate, and generate spoken interaction; \emph{auditory agency} denotes the causal path from that interaction to stateful decisions and observable consequences. The \emph{commitment boundary} marks where revisable auditory evidence becomes persistent state, a plan, or an executable request. \emph{Agency closure} then follows an authorized action through observation, verification, recovery or compensation, and communication of the outcome. Evidence from full-duplex interaction, reasoning, memory, tools, embodiment, and human control shows a consistent systems-level mismatch: integration is advancing faster than end-to-end observation of what the integrated system actually does. The resulting design problem is to preserve a trace from spoken evidence to consequence while keeping commitment, execution, and verification attributable.
summary_zh: 语音系统融合流式语音、推理与工具使用后，仅靠识别质量已无法衡量系统，需关注语音输入引发状态变化的问题。
提出听觉能动性概念，用承诺边界界定证据转为持久状态的节点，并用能动性闭环追踪授权动作的执行与验证。
发现系统集成快于端到端观测，设计挑战在于保持语音证据到结果的追踪，并使承诺、执行与验证可归责。

title: MAS-BIT: A Multi-Agent System for End-to-End BraIn-to-Text Decoding
title_zh: MAS-BIT：端到端脑信号转文本的多智能体系统
abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces aim to restore communication by translating neural activity into text, yet end-to-end decoders have historically trailed cascaded systems in accuracy. We introduce a Multi-Agent System for BraIn-to-Text (MAS-BIT), the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings. MAS-BIT coordinates three specialized agents: a neural agent that interprets continuous neural representations, a phonetic agent that decodes soft phoneme posteriors, and an arbitration agent that integrates their complementary evidence with direct access to neural representations to generate the final transcription. The expert agents communicate with the arbiter through token-embedding-based latent communication, constructing continuous messages as probability-weighted combinations of token embeddings. These messages retain alternative token hypotheses and provide a differentiable interface through which sentence-level supervision jointly trains the neural encoders and specialized agents across participants. MAS-BIT achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end decoding performance on the Brain-to-Text '24 and '25 benchmarks, with word error rates of 6.929% on '24 and 3.606% on the '25 public test set (3.892% on the private test set). These results surpass the published BIT cascade on the '25 public set and narrow the gap on '24, without ensembling independently trained models or using external language-model rescoring.
summary_zh: 端到端脑信号解码文本的准确率通常低于级联系统，需探索新框架提升性能。
提出多智能体框架MAS-BIT，协调神经、语音及仲裁智能体，通过可微潜通信整合互补证据生成文本。
在Brain-to-Text基准上达到SOTA，无需集成或外部语言模型重打分即缩小与级联系统的差距。

title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
title_zh: RumiFold：让LLM原生折叠蛋白质并推理其功能
abstract: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: https://rumifold.baulab.info
summary_zh: 现有通用语言模型难以直接从内部状态预测蛋白质结构，需探索其折叠能力及对功能推理的潜在影响。
提出RumiFold，通过重复折叠过程处理蛋白质，并利用折叠后的表征以自然语言回答功能问题。
模型在折叠精度上媲美专用模型，在功能预测上达SOTA，证明折叠预训练能将结构与语言推理整合。

title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
title_zh: 语音LLM能否识别音频证据不足？诊断与预生成探针缓解方法
abstract: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. Reliance on synthesized speech has been named as a limitation of audio benchmarks but not quantified; we quantify it, and show it large enough to reverse a finding. Since no prompt we tested repairs the residual failure, we transfer pre-generation attention probing to the multimodal setting. A probe over frozen prompt representations reaches 0.773 AUROC at predicting which unanswerable questions the model will answer anyway, where semantic entropy over ten sampled generations is at chance: the model fabricates the same answer every time, so sample disagreement cannot see a failure it is confident about.
summary_zh: 现有评估多关注有答案的语音问答，本文探究语音LLM在录音无法回答问题时的表现及评估方法的可靠性。
在合成语音上端到端模型幻觉率极高，但在真实人声录音上该结论被推翻，证明过度依赖合成语音会逆转研究结论。
提出基于预生成注意力探针的方法，能以0.773的AUROC预测模型对不可回答问题的幻觉，优于语义熵采样方法。
comment: 18 pages, 6 tables. Accepted as a poster at SSPP 2026 (SMILES School Projects & Proceedings). Preprint also available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24347252. Code: https://github.com/ladnlav/slm-audio-evidence

title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
title_zh: 面向个性化游戏交互的情感感知与上下文锚定对话Agent
abstract: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially captures players' emotional shifts over time; responses are more naturalistic and human-like with appropriate conversational cues, pauses, and sighs; and utterances remain faithful to the dynamics of in-game context and player actions, supporting narrative continuity.
summary_zh: 现有NPC对话难以动态适应玩家情绪变化与游戏情境，影响沉浸感。提出ChatNPC，利用序列数据结合玩家信息、台词与游戏上下文进行实时个性化响应。
方法将任务拆分为游戏哨兵引导Agent、记忆能力与聊天规划工具，利用LLM工具调用提取记忆信息并识别约束，实现准确推理。
实验表明，ChatNPC能持续捕捉玩家情绪变化，生成包含停顿与叹息等自然线索的拟人化回复，且忠实于游戏动态以维持叙事连贯性。

title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
title_zh: SAE-Audit：基于稀疏自编码器证据的黑盒LLM推理时优化方法
abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.
summary_zh: 临床试验结果预测困难，前沿LLM预测可靠性低且理由难以反映真实证据，仅略高于随机水平。
提出SAE-Audit，利用冻结SAE构建临床概念词汇表，通过稀疏探针提取证据，在推理时优化黑盒LLM。
无需额外训练即可显著提升模型预测准确率，并提供可验证的概念级证据与自然语言解释，大幅超越其他方法。
comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit

title: BenchMint: From Real-World Tasks to Executable Benchmarks
title_zh: BenchMint：从真实世界任务到可执行基准
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) need evaluations of everyday reasoning and tool use, such as planning itineraries under user constraints and grounding numerical answers in evidence. We introduce BenchMint, an automated benchmark-construction workflow, and Daily-Life, its collection of 100 selected tasks across 11 real-world domains. BenchMint jointly constructs tasks and scoring criteria from the same source documents. Language-model judges assess possible answers against these criteria using tool traces and private evidence. We report 26 model/harness configurations, including GPT, Claude and Gemini families; 17 have complete domain profiles. These are descriptive configuration results, not a controlled model ranking. In one selected travel task, we corrected the reference total from 320 to 380 minutes while keeping both answers unchanged. The incorrect answer's arithmetic verdict switched from pass to fail; the correct answer's switched from fail to pass. With one ballot per cell, this exposes a reference error without establishing repeatability or collection-wide validity. Incomplete construction comparisons establish no general advantage of joint authoring or feedback-guided revision.
summary_zh: LLM缺乏日常推理与工具使用的评估方法，提出自动化基准构建流程BenchMint及涵盖11个领域的100项任务。
方法联合构建任务与评分标准，由语言模型评判依据工具轨迹和私有证据评估答案，并测试了26种模型配置。
结论表明该流程能暴露参考答案错误，但未证明联合构建或反馈引导修订具有普遍优势。
comment: Supplementary analysis and reproducibility materials are included as ancillary files

title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
title_zh: 端点条件过程价值：已知终态与成本时过程评分的增益
abstract: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict inflates its standalone discrimination by +0.103, while reference disclosure and tool-output redaction move it by nothing an interval separates from zero. A process metric reported without the judge's scale and evidence access does not identify a quantity. We release the protocol, the sealed-endpoint harness, and all trajectories.
summary_zh: 现有轨迹评估缺乏在已知结果与成本下对过程评分增益的量化，本文构建了包含密封结果、终态成本基线及评判尺度等因子的对比框架。
在1255条轨迹上的实验表明，过程评分的增益取决于评判模型，仅Qwen3 32B在已知成本外带来+0.050的AUC提升。
过程评分的大部分增益可由行为计数恢复，且披露终态会膨胀其判别力，因此无评判尺度与证据访问设定的过程指标无意义。

title: More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
title_zh: 面向泛化机器人操作的运动导向潜在推理方法
abstract: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. Semantic latents, following the stages of embodied chain-of-thought, first establish what to accomplish and how. Conditioned on them, motion-oriented latents anticipate each future step from coarse to fine: from the global scene, to the interaction region spanned by the manipulated object and its destination, to the robot state. Relative to the state-of-the-art latent VLA LaST$_0$, our method raises the mean success rate on SimplerEnv-WidowX from 37.5% to 55.2% in distribution and from 22.4% to 30.2% under out-of-distribution shifts, and on an AgileX Piper dual-arm platform from 60.8% to 90.8% in training scenes and from 6.7% to 37.5% under environmental changes.
summary_zh: 现有VLA模型依赖视觉前瞻进行潜在推理，但受限于训练场景外观，场景变化时性能急剧下降。
提出运动导向潜在推理方法，将视觉潜在变量从整体帧转向动作交互，由粗到细预测未来步骤。
实验表明该方法显著提升了同分布及分布外场景下的机器人操作成功率，泛化能力优于现有方法。

title: CXL Coherence Writes Back What Surviving Hosts See, Leaving Flushes Only for Ordering
title_zh: CXL一致性写回机制：仅保留用于排序的刷新
abstract: Hosts that share memory over Compute Express Link (CXL) cache its lines, and a host that crashes loses the lines it has modified and not written back. Designs for such memory stop every host when one crashes, assume stored energy, or flush after each operation. We show that when a crashing host's clients die with it, the flushes a host crash requires are those that keep one line from reaching the memory device before a line it depends on, and not those that make a finished operation durable. The reason is a property that CXL requires of the fabric: a modified line is written back before another host accesses it. Whatever a surviving host has seen is then on the device, and our crash condition lets a crash drop operations that only the crashed host observed. We prove the claim for operations that take effect in a single store, and test it on small instances of models of three published designs, whose operations store several times. A lock table needs no flush to keep the locks of surviving hosts. A persistent hash index keeps every operation a survivor has observed, and in two workloads it writes fewer than half as many lines to the device as its published code does. An allocator's flush of each new reference is neither sufficient nor necessary for the survivors' safety: the allocator lacks ordering flushes, one of them when a reference changes hands.
summary_zh: CXL共享内存中主机崩溃会丢失未写回的缓存行，现有设计需停止所有主机、依赖储能或每次操作后刷新。
利用CXL要求修改行在被其他主机访问前写回的特性，证明崩溃时仅需保持依赖行顺序的刷新，无需为已完成操作持久化刷新。
在锁表、持久哈希索引和分配器等模型上验证，幸存主机数据安全得到保障，且显著减少了写回设备的缓存行数量。

title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
title_zh: EMIP：基于Minecraft的具身多方交互平台
abstract: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).
summary_zh: 研究人类与具身AI协作缺乏支持多方语音与物理动作并行的实验平台，提出基于Minecraft的虚拟环境平台EMIP。
该平台采用客户端-服务器架构，支持多人与多AI agent全双工语音通信及同步物理交互，并基于MCP提供环境观测与动作执行接口。
平台集成集中控制、多agent协作搬运及实验记录等功能，支持基于LLM开发控制方法，促进人机与agent间协作研究。

title: Multi-Agent Coordinated Method-Level Refactoring of Rust Code
title_zh: 基于多智能体协同的Rust代码方法级重构
abstract: As Rust codebases evolve, developers refactor code to reduce duplication, simplify complex methods, and keep related functionality together. Developers can make these changes manually or use IDE assists for supported operations, then check the resulting code with compiler diagnostics and tests. Method-level refactoring in Rust must preserve observable behavior while accounting for ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes. We present a large language model (LLM)-based workflow for extracting, inlining, and moving methods in Rust. The workflow combines candidate generation, configurable specialist review,and container-based validation. On six tasks from three open-source Rust projects, three end-to-end configurations passed all task checks on their first attempt, using 6, 13, and 31 model calls. To isolate the effect of review, we then gave four configurations the same six reference patches and six deliberately behavior-changing variants. A designated specialist rejected all six behavior-changing patches before container validation and let all six reference patches proceed, reducing Docker invocations from 24 to 12 relative to direct validation. The fixed specialist panel also caught all six faults early and rejected two reference patches over unmeasured performance concerns. On this workload, specialist review reduced execution work, while its effect on total time depended on review overhead and which patches reached validation.
summary_zh: Rust方法级重构需在保持行为一致的前提下处理所有权与生命周期等复杂特性，传统手动或IDE辅助方式存在局限。
提出基于LLM的工作流，结合候选生成、可配置专家审查与容器化验证，实现Rust方法的提取、内联与移动。
实验表明专家审查能提前拦截行为变更补丁，有效减少容器验证次数与执行开销，为代码重构提供可靠保障。

title: CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation
title_zh: CT-Navigator：基于智能体感知与工具调用的CT理解框架
abstract: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct_navigator}{GitHub}.
summary_zh: 现有3D医学MLLM缺乏迭代推理与视觉证据溯源能力，难以支持可追踪的CT解读。
提出CT-Navigator框架，利用通用MLLM的2D视觉与agent能力，通过分层视觉探索和工具调用逐步定位视觉证据。
构建V-CoT数据集进行微调与强化学习，在CTNavi-Bench上准确率达79.50%，超越最强基线17.59%。

title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
title_zh: 大语言模型演进综述：从梯度消失到递归自我改进
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).
summary_zh: 早期RNN存在遗忘上下文的问题，LSTM引入门控机制选择性保留长期记忆，Word2Vec将语言转化为向量数学，奠定了表示学习基础。
RNN受限于序列计算难以并行，Transformer引入全局注意力机制开启现代LLM时代，但带来计算复杂度的二次方瓶颈。
单纯扩大参数会导致训练不充分，需同步扩展数据规模；RLHF对齐较为表面，导致易受对抗性越狱攻击，当前正向闭环递归自我改进演进。

title: Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English
title_zh: 超越遗漏：衡量LLM在孟加拉语和英语中的关键信息满足度
abstract: Evaluations of multilingual trustworthiness often ask whether a model leaves out information that a user needs. We examine whether that question is sufficient. Using 157 matched tasks written in English (EN), natural Bengali (BN) and Bengali-matrix Bengali-English code-switching (BN-CS), we scored 1,413 responses from three models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 12B) against required information units (RIUs) fixed before any model was run. The scoring separates outright omission from content that is present but incorrect, insufficient or only partly met. The prespecified primary estimand, the domain-equal paired difference in critical omission rate (BN - EN), showed no detectable difference (+0.003, 95% CI -0.014 to +0.015), with omission near zero in every condition. The Bengali deficit appeared in fulfillment instead. Critical coverage was 0.050 lower in Bengali (95% CI 0.022 to 0.079) and strict complete-task success 0.093 lower (95% CI 0.055 to 0.131); both gaps came from the two open-weight models, and Sol showed none. Code-switching recovered part of the loss in RIU coverage (+0.028, 95% CI 0.012 to 0.045). On these data, an omission count alone would have shown no language gap. The automated judge passed prespecified agreement gates after a documented failed first attempt. A blind native-speaker rating of 60 study responses agreed with it on RIU scores (alpha 0.84) and critical RIUs (98% exact) but fell short on Bengali RIU agreement (alpha 0.77) and on the unsupported-content check (93% exact), and a blind check of its reason codes agreed on whether a critical unit was omitted for 79 of 81 units. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code are released.
summary_zh: 多语言可信度评估通常关注模型是否遗漏用户所需信息，但仅衡量遗漏可能不足以揭示真实的语言差异。
研究使用预定义信息单元对三个模型在英语和孟加拉语等任务上的表现进行评分，区分遗漏与内容不正确或不充分。
结果显示孟加拉语和英语的遗漏率无差异，但孟加拉语在信息覆盖和任务成功率上存在缺陷，语码转换可部分弥补该损失。
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code: https://github.com/HeyAvijitRoy/multilingual-trustworthiness-study

title: RSLaA: Self-Reconfiguring Roadside LiDARs as Agents for 3D Traffic Perception
title_zh: RSLaA：将路边LiDAR作为智能体实现3D交通感知
abstract: Cooperative perception with roadside LiDARs (RSLs) extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles and resolves onboard-sensor occlusions, particularly at curves and intersections. Because infrastructure deployment is costly, existing work optimizes RSL configurations once, against road geometry and aggregated traffic statistics, and treats them as fixed thereafter. Traffic flow, however, is inherently dynamic, and a placement optimal on average can be far from optimal at any given moment. We introduce RSLaA (Roadside LiDARs as Agents), a framework in which each RSL adaptively adjusts its pose to the evolving traffic scene over decision-time windows. Since ground truth is unavailable at decision time, the framework centers on surrogate metrics computed solely from a probabilistic occupancy grid of historical observations, which predicts the next-window perception performance of candidate poses. We construct a co-simulation benchmark pairing five candidate surrogates with detector-agnostic ground-truth perception labels at every decision window, identifying the multi-view coverage metric J_mv as the most reliable predictor. Upon this validated surrogate we build two adaptive configuration methods, a receding-horizon (MPC) optimizer and a lightweight MAPPO-based multi-agent reinforcement learning scheme with centralized training and decentralized execution. Across 10 sites and 89 six-hour traffic scenarios (890 evaluation runs), adaptive configuration consistently improves the composite perception score over static deployment. Our results indicate that RSLs could be benefitted from being treated as agents.
summary_zh: 路边LiDAR固定部署无法适应动态交通流，导致瞬时感知性能下降
提出RSLaA框架，利用历史观测的概率占据网格计算代理指标，并采用MPC和MAPPO算法自适应调整LiDAR位姿
在多场景仿真中验证多视角覆盖指标最可靠，自适应配置显著优于静态部署

title: GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes
title_zh: GALILEO：面向动态场景的几何旋转位置编码
abstract: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.
summary_zh: 现有几何感知旋转位置编码假设场景静态，在动态场景中会因物体运动导致渲染位置不准。
提出伽利略平移方法，利用估计速度与时间偏移将 key 的 3D 位置传输至查询时刻，兼容现有编码。
该方法提升了动态视图合成质量，并降低了 3D 点追踪误差与改进了视频生成。

title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
title_zh: 基于LLM的狗狗护理指导助手
